# Square World Logistics

> Square World Logistics is a global logistics and freight forwarding provider established in 2023, offering comprehensive end-to-end logistics solutions across 220+ countries. We specialize in international air express, air freight, sea freight, customs clearance, and customized logistics solutions for businesses of all sizes.

## Core Services

- [International Air Express](https://www.squareworldlogistics.com/services/air-express): Fast, secure door-to-door courier services for time-sensitive packages and documents worldwide.
- [International Air Freight](https://www.squareworldlogistics.com/services/air-freight): Efficient commercial cargo shipping with flexible consolidation and airport-to-airport options.
- [International Sea Freight](https://www.squareworldlogistics.com/services/sea-freight): Economical FCL and LCL maritime shipping solutions with global port connectivity.
- [Tailor-Made Freight Solutions](https://www.squareworldlogistics.com/services/tailor-made): Bespoke logistics planning designed around custom budgets, timelines, and freight requirements.
- [Customs Clearance Service](https://www.squareworldlogistics.com/services/customs): Hassle-free customs brokerage, regulatory compliance, and import/export documentation management.

## Key Facts

- **Established**: 2023
- **Coverage**: 220+ Countries Worldwide

- **Global Partners**: FedEx, UPS, DHL, Aramex

## Leadership

- **Priyank Mistry (Founder)**: Focuses on redefining logistics through radical transparency, operational integrity, and a customer-first mindset.
- **Spandan Behera (Co-Founder)**: Directs operations with agility, ensuring human expertise and streamlined systems connect every parcel successfully.

## Operations & Compliance

### Standard Incoterms Supported
- EXW (Ex Works), FOB (Free On Board), CIF (Cost Insurance & Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), DAP (Delivered At Place)

### Prohibited Items
Narcotic drugs, firearms, explosives, radioactive substances, currency/bullion, precious stones, live animals, hazardous waste, counterfeit goods.
